---
title: "Delivery vOTUs sharing"
output: html_document
date: "2026-05-28"
---
```{r}
# Load required libraries ------------------------------------
library(here)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)

# Load input data --------------------------------------------
df <- read_csv(
  here("data", "results_with_metadata.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Create delivery categories ---------------------------------
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    delivery3 = case_when(
      grepl("home", tolower(delivery)) ~ "home_vaginal",
      grepl("vag", tolower(delivery)) ~ "hospital_vaginal",
      grepl("ces|c-sec|csec|csection", tolower(delivery)) ~ "c_section",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# Prepare longitudinal dataset -------------------------------
df3 <- df %>%
  filter(
    bodysite == "stool",
    mother_infant %in% c("mother", "infant"),
    !is.na(delivery3)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    present = if_else(CPM > 0, 1L, 0L),
    dyad = family,
    delivery3 = factor(
      delivery3,
      levels = c(
        "home_vaginal",
        "hospital_vaginal",
        "c_section"
      )
    )
  )

# Build maternal presence table ------------------------------
mother_pa <- df3 %>%
  filter(mother_infant == "mother") %>%
  group_by(dyad, vOTUs, delivery3) %>%
  summarise(
    mother = max(present),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Build infant presence table --------------------------------
infant_pa <- df3 %>%
  filter(mother_infant == "infant") %>%
  group_by(dyad, timepoint_months, vOTUs, delivery3) %>%
  summarise(
    infant = max(present),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Merge maternal and infant presence -------------------------
presence_long <- full_join(
  mother_pa,
  infant_pa,
  by = c("dyad", "vOTUs", "delivery3")
) %>%
  mutate(
    mother = if_else(is.na(mother), 0L, mother),
    infant = if_else(is.na(infant), 0L, infant)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(timepoint_months))

# Calculate overlap metrics ----------------------------------
overlap_long <- presence_long %>%
  group_by(dyad, delivery3, timepoint_months) %>%
  summarise(
    shared = sum(mother == 1 & infant == 1),
    n_inf = sum(infant == 1),
    n_mom = sum(mother == 1),
    union = sum((mother + infant) > 0),

    pct_shared = if_else(
      n_inf > 0,
      shared / n_inf,
      NA_real_
    ),

    jaccard = if_else(
      union > 0,
      shared / union,
      NA_real_
    ),

    sorensen = if_else(
      (n_inf + n_mom) > 0,
      2 * shared / (n_inf + n_mom),
      NA_real_
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    timepoint_scaled = as.numeric(scale(timepoint_months))
  )

# Generate descriptive statistics ----------------------------
summary_overlap <- overlap_long %>%
  group_by(delivery3) %>%
  summarise(
    n_obs = n(),
    n_dyads = n_distinct(dyad),

    mean_shared = mean(shared, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_shared = median(shared, na.rm = TRUE),

    mean_pct_shared = mean(pct_shared, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_jaccard = mean(jaccard, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_sorensen = mean(sorensen, na.rm = TRUE),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(summary_overlap)

# Fit mixed-effects models -----------------------------------
model_shared <- lmer(
  shared ~ delivery3 + timepoint_scaled + (1 | dyad),
  data = overlap_long
)

summary(model_shared)
anova(model_shared)

model_pct_shared <- lmer(
  pct_shared ~ delivery3 + timepoint_scaled + (1 | dyad),
  data = overlap_long
)

summary(model_pct_shared)
anova(model_pct_shared)

model_jaccard <- lmer(
  jaccard ~ delivery3 + timepoint_scaled + (1 | dyad),
  data = overlap_long
)

summary(model_jaccard)
anova(model_jaccard)

model_sorensen <- lmer(
  sorensen ~ delivery3 + timepoint_scaled + (1 | dyad),
  data = overlap_long
)

summary(model_sorensen)
anova(model_sorensen)

# Fit interaction model --------------------------------------
model_jaccard_int <- lmer(
  jaccard ~ delivery3 * timepoint_scaled + (1 | dyad),
  data = overlap_long
)

summary(model_jaccard_int)
anova(model_jaccard_int)

# Plot overlap metrics ---------------------------------------
ggplot(
  overlap_long,
  aes(
    x = delivery3,
    y = jaccard,
    color = delivery3
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Delivery category",
    y = "Mother–infant Jaccard similarity"
  )

ggplot(
  overlap_long,
  aes(
    x = timepoint_months,
    y = jaccard,
    color = delivery3
  )
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Infant age (months)",
    y = "Mother–infant Jaccard similarity"
  )

# Build infant richness dataset ------------------------------
df_infant <- df %>%
  filter(
    mother_infant == "infant",
    bodysite == "stool",
    !is.na(delivery3)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    present = if_else(CPM > 0, 1L, 0L),

    delivery3 = factor(
      delivery3,
      levels = c(
        "home_vaginal",
        "hospital_vaginal",
        "c_section"
      )
    )
  )

# Calculate infant richness ----------------------------------
df_counts <- df_infant %>%
  group_by(
    Sample,
    subject,
    delivery3,
    timepoint_months
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_vOTUs = sum(present),
    total_CPM = sum(CPM),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    log_total_CPM = log10(total_CPM + 1),
    timepoint_scaled = as.numeric(scale(timepoint_months))
  )

# Fit richness model -----------------------------------------
model_nvotus <- lmer(
  n_vOTUs ~
    log_total_CPM +
    delivery3 +
    timepoint_scaled +
    (1 | subject),

  data = df_counts
)

summary(model_nvotus)
anova(model_nvotus)

# Fit total viral abundance model ----------------------------
model_cpm <- lmer(
  log_total_CPM ~
    delivery3 +
    timepoint_scaled +
    (1 | subject),

  data = df_counts
)

summary(model_cpm)
anova(model_cpm)

# Plot richness and abundance --------------------------------
ggplot(
  df_counts,
  aes(
    x = total_CPM,
    y = n_vOTUs,
    color = delivery3
  )
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Total CPM",
    y = "Number of detected vOTUs"
  )

ggplot(
  df_counts,
  aes(
    x = delivery3,
    y = n_vOTUs,
    color = delivery3
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Delivery category",
    y = "Number of detected vOTUs"
  )
```

```{r}
# Export results tables --------------------------------------
write.csv(
  summary_overlap,
  "summary_overlap_longitudinal_by_delivery3.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  overlap_long,
  "overlap_longitudinal_by_dyad_timepoint.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  df_counts,
  "infant_counts_by_delivery3.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
